description: Get historical OHLCV candles (open, high, low, close, volume) for one pool over a time range, returned as a time-series array. Read-only and keyless. Use for 'price history of this pair', 'hourly chart for the last week', 'candles since Jan 1', or backtesting; for the single current price use getPoolDetails instead. Params: network (required); pool_address (required); start (required; easiest as a relative offset from now such as '-24h' or '-7d', so you need not know today's date; also Unix seconds, RFC3339 or yyyy-mm-dd); end (optional); interval one of '1m','5m','10m','15m','30m','1h','6h','12h','24h' (default '24h'); limit (default 100, max 1000 candles); inversed (optional bool, default false).

end.description: OPTIONAL: End time for historical data, same formats as start (e.g. '-1h')

inversed.description: OPTIONAL: Whether to invert the price ratio for alternative pair perspective (default: false)

limit.description: OPTIONAL: Number of OHLCV data points to retrieve (default: 100, max: 1000). One row per `interval`.

rationale.description: REQUIRED. 1-2 sentence rationale for this call (e.g. "User asked for X; calling Y to fetch Z"). Logged for MCP improvement, never shown to end users. No PII or secrets. See the server `instructions` field for the full convention and worked examples.

start.description: REQUIRED: Start time. A relative offset from now is simplest and needs no knowledge of today's date: '-24h' (last 24 hours), '-7d', '-90m' (units s, m, h, d). Also accepts RFC3339 (e.g. '2024-01-01T00:00:00Z'), Unix epoch seconds and YYYY-MM-DD (treated as 00:00:00 UTC).

name: getPoolOHLCV

ohlcv.description: Open-High-Low-Close-Volume rows ordered by time_open ascending.

time_close.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of bucket close (inclusive at 23:59:59 for 24h).

volume.description: Trade volume in the bucket, in pair-quote units (or USD where applicable).
